clarified_criteria: Create an HTTP(S) short link with optional alias and expiry.
Return 302 for a live code, 404 for an unknown code, and 410 for an expired code.
Record one visit for a successful GET redirect and expose the stored count.
clarification: Build the greenfield short link service: users create HTTP(S) links with optional aliases and expiry, resolve live codes, and inspect redirect counts. Unknown codes return 404. Do not add analytics beyond the supported link statistics.
